description: OpenAPI analyzer + tool generator — Reads a JSON OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 spec from a URL: title, version, servers, auth schemes, operation list (method, path, operationId, params, body), tag/method stats, and a lint report (missing operationIds, duplicate ids, undeclared path params, missing 2xx responses, unresolved $refs) with score and grade. tools=openai|anthropic|mcp also converts every operation into ready-to-use LLM tool/function definitions with $refs resolved (max_tools= up to 200). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: dev_openapi
